a.source: Values read from submission/Figures/fig_2.pdf (vector): each polygon vertex's distance from the radar centre, converted to the plotted value through the three labelled grid circles (linear fit, residual < 0.01). Values are per-state means z-scored across SecA, Intermediate, SecB and ciliated cells (figures/_prep/fig2a_functional_state_summaries.py). PROGENy, Hallmark and DoRothEA equal the recomputed values; scFEA is the published run (see each radar's check).

radars.title: PROGENy
radars.note: Clockwise from the top axis. r_range = value at the centre and at the outer circle.

radars.title: Hallmark
radars.note: Clockwise from the top axis. r_range = value at the centre and at the outer circle.

radars.note: Clockwise from the top axis. r_range = value at the centre and at the outer circle.

radars.check: a rerun of scFEA does not reproduce the published flux exactly (max |diff| 0.24, TCA entry); the values here are the published ones, which also match the flux block of Figure S8

b.source: Recomputed: figures/_prep/fig2b_cell_cycle_phase.py (scanpy score_genes_cell_cycle, Tirosh S and G2/M lists, on normalised log counts of all 575,366 epithelial cells)

c.source: Recomputed (rules of figures/figure2/02_fig2bcde_cellcycle_composition_paired.py): epithelial cells pooled per group; site groups are pre-treatment cells by metastatic site; treatment groups are primary-tumour cells

d.source: Recomputed (rules of 02_fig2bcde): pre-treatment patients with ascites and at least one other site, >= 100 epithelial cells per site; one value per patient and site
d.title: Patient-matched (n = 14)
d.note: Unit ids are anonymous and specific to this panel. Brackets: ** p < 0.01, ns = not significant.

e.source: Recomputed (rules of 02_fig2bcde): patients with >= 100 epithelial cells before and after chemotherapy; samples pooled per time point, not site-matched
e.title: Patient-matched (n = 18)
e.note: Unit ids are anonymous and specific to this panel.

f.source: Recomputed: figures/_prep/fig2f_consensusov.py (whole-sample raw-count pseudobulk, edgeR TMM, log2(CPM + 1), consensusOV) with the 25-seed consensus of fig2f_consensusov_multiseed.R; state % per sample from the final-atlas epithelial states
f.note: SecA[i] and SecB[i] are the same sample. Boxes: quartiles, whiskers to the most extreme value within 1.5 IQR (matplotlib default); outliers are drawn only as points.

g.source: Recomputed pseudobulk (figures/figure2/04_fig2g_pseudobulk_volcano.py rules: tumour x state profiles, >= 10 cells, tumours with both states; 261 tumours, 522 profiles; genes with total count >= 10) tested with PyDESeq2 0.5.4, Wald test SecB vs SecA, Benjamini-Hochberg. The values below use design ~epitype (not paired by tumour): this reproduces the submitted fig_2.pdf exactly (14 signature-gene markers within 0.01; -log10 adj. p cap 57). The legend and Table S6 describe the paired design ~tumour + state; those results are under 'paired' (they do not match the drawn markers: max |diff| 144.9).

display.note: The figure clips -log10 adj. p at the cap (ceil of the 99.5th percentile) and log2FC to [-5.9, 5.9]; padj of 0 is taken as 1e-300; genes with padj = null are not drawn.

paired.design: ~sample + epitype (paired within tumours; legend and Table S6)
paired.note: Same genes and order as the top-level arrays. Matches Table S6 (median |log2FC diff| 0.0000 over 356 genes).
